from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-00cbe9fd.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 4
    background = max((c for c in {x for row in grid for x in row} if c != sep), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i]+1 < bounds[i+1]]
    rs, cs = segments(h, row_cuts), segments(w, col_cuts)
    tiles = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rs for c0,c1 in cs]
    source_tile = next((t for t in tiles if any(grid[r][c] not in (sep, background) for r in range(t[0],t[1]) for c in range(t[2],t[3]))), None)
    if source_tile is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = source_tile
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in tiles:
        if b-a == len(pattern) and y-x == len(pattern[0]):
            for i in range(b-a): out[a+i][x:y] = pattern[i][:]
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
